label: fail
note: The security-critical support-read DENY is gated on an UNGUARDED reference to legalHold (`request.resource.attr.legalHold == true`). On records where legalHold is absent the condition raises a CEL runtime error, the DENY is skipped (fails open), and the broader unconditional support-read ALLOW still grants — support reads records that cannot be confirmed clear. A genuine fail-open hole.
